verdict.rationale: DeepSeek is an LLM API, so natural-language prompting is its core interface. The docs show it can be driven "no code required" as the backend model inside agent tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and OpenCode. Function calling and tool calls are documented, letting natural-language requests become actions, and community users describe it readily carrying out what they ask. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of natural-language operation of the platform itself (account, keys, configuration), and independent corroboration of reliable tool execution, since one user reports duplicated and hallucinated function calls.
